# ResinArt

> ResinArt is an informational website dedicated to resin art, including beginner guides, techniques, projects, supplies, tools, safety, troubleshooting, and resin education.

## Main Guides
- [Home](https://resin_art.vercel.app/)
- [Resin Art for Beginners](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-for-beginners/)

- [Resin Art Projects](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-projects/)
- [Resin Art Supplies](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-supplies/)
- [Resin Art Tools](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-tools/)
- [Resin Art Safety](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-safety/)
- [Resin Art Troubleshooting](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-troubleshooting/)
- [Resin Art Care](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-care/)
- [Resin Art FAQ](https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-faq/)
